email.accountFooter: This is an automatic notice about your {organization} account. It is sent whenever this happens and needs no reply.
email.membershipFooter: This is an automatic notice from {organization} about your membership. It needs no reply.

notYouWithoutAccess: If this wasn't you, contact your administrator right away.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Hi {name}, the password for your {organization} account was just changed.
passwordChanged.otherSessionsRevoked: Every other device signed in to your account was signed out.
passwordChanged.guidance: If this wasn't you, reset your password from the sign-in page right away, and contact your administrator.

emailChangeRequested.subject: A new email address was requested for your account
emailChangeRequested.body: Hi {name}, someone signed in to your {organization} account asked to move it to a new email address.
emailChangeRequested.pending: Nothing changes until the confirmation link sent to the new address is followed.
emailChangeRequested.guidance: If this wasn't you, change your password now so the request cannot be completed, and contact your administrator.

emailChanged.subject: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.body: Hi {name}, your {organization} account no longer uses this address. Signing in and future notices now use the new one.
emailChanged.guidance: If this wasn't you, contact your administrator right away: this address can no longer be used to sign in or to reset your password.

twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned on
twoFactorEnabled.body: Hi {name}, two-factor authentication is now on for your {organization} account. Signing in needs a code from your authenticator app as well as your password.
twoFactorEnabled.guidance: If this wasn't you, someone else can sign in as you: change your password and review your two-factor settings, and contact your administrator.

twoFactorDisabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off
twoFactorDisabled.body: Hi {name}, two-factor authentication was turned off for your {organization} account. Signing in now needs only your password.
twoFactorDisabled.guidance: If this wasn't you, change your password and turn two-factor authentication back on, and contact your administrator.

backupCodesRegenerated.subject: New backup codes were created
backupCodesRegenerated.body: Hi {name}, a new set of backup codes was created for your {organization} account. Your previous backup codes no longer work.
backupCodesRegenerated.guidance: If this wasn't you, change your password and create new backup codes yourself, and contact your administrator.

passkeyAdded.subject: A passkey was added to your account
passkeyAdded.body: Hi {name}, a new passkey can now be used to sign in to your {organization} account.
passkeyAdded.guidance: If this wasn't you, remove the passkey and change your password, and contact your administrator.

passkeyRemoved.subject: A passkey was removed from your account
passkeyRemoved.body: Hi {name}, a passkey can no longer be used to sign in to your {organization} account.
passkeyRemoved.guidance: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your passkeys, and contact your administrator.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: Hi {name}, your {organization} account was deleted, along with every organization membership it had. This cannot be undone.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.body: Hi {name}, your {organization} account was just signed in to from a device it has not used recently.
newSignIn.guidance: If this wasn't you, change your password, sign out the sessions you do not recognise, and contact your administrator.

accountDisabled.subject: Your account was disabled
accountDisabled.body: Hi {name}, an administrator disabled your {organization} account. You cannot sign in to it, or to anything that uses it, until it is enabled again.
accountDisabled.guidance: If you think this is a mistake, contact your administrator.

accountEnabled.subject: Your account was enabled again
accountEnabled.body: Hi {name}, an administrator enabled your {organization} account again. You can sign in as before.
accountEnabled.guidance: If you did not expect this, contact your administrator.

memberAdded.subject: You were added to {organization}
memberAdded.body: Hi {name}, {actor} added you to {organization} as {role}. Sign in with your existing account to get started.
memberAdded.guidance: If you did not expect this, contact an administrator of {organization}.

memberRoleChanged.subject: Your role in {organization} changed
memberRoleChanged.body: Hi {name}, {actor} changed your role in {organization} from {from} to {to}.
memberRoleChanged.guidance: If you think this is a mistake, contact an administrator of {organization}.

breakGlassStarted.subject: A root administrator entered {organization}
breakGlassStarted.body: Hi {name}, {actor} administers this Bedrock instance and has opened break-glass access to {organization}. For the next {minutes, number} minutes they can act as an owner there, and everything they do is recorded in its audit log.
breakGlassStarted.guidance: Break-glass access exists to repair an organization nobody inside can fix any more. If you did not expect it, contact the administrators of this instance.

memberRemoved.subject: You were removed from {organization}
memberRemoved.body: Hi {name}, {actor} removed you from {organization}. You can no longer sign in to it or to the applications it gives you.
memberRemoved.guidance: If you think this is a mistake, contact an administrator of {organization}.

invitationAccepted.subject: {invitee} accepted your invitation to {organization}
invitationAccepted.body: Hi {name}, {invitee} ({inviteeEmail}) accepted your invitation and joined {organization} as {role}.
invitationAccepted.guidance: If you did not invite them, review the members of {organization}.
